In `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`:

- **`askDM()`** calls primary model `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`; if it throws, it catches the error and retries with fallback model `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`. If that also fails, it returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.
- **`parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`** handles malformed JSON: strips markdown fences, regex-extracts the first `{...}` block if the text isn't pure JSON, and wraps `JSON.parse` in try/catch — any failure (empty string, no JSON found, parse error) returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.
- **`fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`** is the shared graceful-degradation function producing a generic narrative + empty/neutral `gameStateChanges`, default `suggestedActions`, and empty `diceRolls`, so the game continues even when AI is unavailable or unparseable.
